quote: N = 101 for all scales except Delinquent (n = 58).
reason: While 101 students were rated overall, Table 5 explicitly notes that ASCA Delinquent has n = 58, and the Table 6 dependent t-test pairing BASC Conduct Problems (M = 61.84, SD = 12.82 vs. M = 59.79, SD = 13.22 in the N = 101 Oppositional Defiant pair) with ASCA Delinquent (M = 54.31, SD = 12.04; t = -3.41, p = .0012, d = .45) is restricted to those 58 paired student ratings.
